title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
summary: Find the greatest length of a strictly increasing subsequence.
statement: Find the greatest length of a strictly increasing subsequence. You may skip elements, but chosen indices must remain in input order.

examples.explanation: Equal values cannot extend a strictly increasing sequence.
Skip 3 and take the remaining values.

hints: Conceptual: A smaller tail gives future elements more room to extend a sequence.
Directional: Keep the smallest attainable ending value for each subsequence length.
Implementation: For each value, replace the first tail at least as large, or extend the tail array if no such entry exists.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space.
